value.rationale: P3 square C5 is the first nontriangular odd-periodic three-row cylinder, a canonical boundary change from the actively studied P3 square Pn matching complexes. Its exact homotopy has nontrivial adjacent dimensions (24 four-spheres and 3 five-spheres); integer attaching-map data are strictly stronger than Euler characteristic or Betti ranks and offer a motivated base case for larger periodic cylinders.
